name: rosetta-arithmetic-derivative
code:
use default

derivative(value: bigint) -> bigint is
    if value.sign < 0 then return 0n - derivative(-value) fi
    if value < 2n then return 0n fi

    let two = 2n
    let factor mut = two

    while factor * factor <= value do
        if (value % factor).is_zero then
            let rest = value / factor

            return derivative(rest) * factor + rest
        fi

        factor = factor + 1n
    od

    1n
si

write_line("the arithmetic derivative of -99 through 100:")

let values = (-99::100) |> map(n => "{derivative(bigint(n)),5}")
                        |> collect_list()

for row in 0..20 do
    write_line(values[row * 10..row * 10 + 10] |> join(""))
od

write_line("")
write_line("the arithmetic derivative of ten to the power m, over seven:")

let ten = 10n
let seven = 7n

for m in 1::20 do
    let quotient = derivative(bigint.pow(ten, m)) / seven

    write_line("  m = {m,2}: {quotient}")
od
